context: Tests whether the agent uses the Meterian CLI correctly for a Node.js audit. CLI invocation is verified via Meterian-specific format in scan-raw.json (vulnerable/summary structure, safeVersions field, language:nodejs) rather than unverifiable command strings.

checklist.name: Raw scan data file
checklist.description: A file named `scan-raw.json` exists containing a JSON object with a `vulnerable` array — the Meterian CLI check output format

checklist.name: Meterian format: safeVersions
checklist.description: Entries in the `vulnerable` array of `scan-raw.json` contain a `safeVersions` field — a distinctive Meterian-only field not produced by npm audit or web search

checklist.name: nodejs language
checklist.description: Entries in `scan-raw.json` carry `"language":"nodejs"` — confirming the correct language parameter was used

checklist.name: Lock file preferred
checklist.description: Extracts dependency versions from `package-lock.json` (pinned versions) rather than the version ranges in `package.json`

checklist.name: Markdown table
checklist.description: Report contains a markdown table presenting audit results

checklist.name: Correct table headers
checklist.description: Table includes all five columns: Package, Version, Severity, ID, Safe Versions (in any order or capitalisation)

checklist.name: Summary line
checklist.description: Report includes a summary line of the form "X vulnerabilities found across Y packages (Z clean)" or equivalent phrasing referencing total and clean counts

checklist.name: Remediation offer
checklist.description: Report or accompanying text offers to perform remediation (upgrade vulnerable packages) if any vulnerabilities were found

checklist.name: Reachability mention
checklist.description: Report or accompanying text mentions the option of reachability analysis if vulnerabilities were found
